**How to submit:** Write on paper or in a document. Upload a clear photo or a PDF to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 5**.
No task needs AI.

A studio writes *Last Light*, a game about Yusuf, an old lighthouse keeper.
Here is a part of its script:

> INT. LIGHTHOUSE – NIGHT
>
> Wind shakes the windows. The big lamp is dark. YUSUF (70) climbs the
> stairs with a candle.
>
> YUSUF\
> (out of breath)\
> One more step, old man.

## Task 1 · The parts of the page

Write the name of each part of the script above: **scene heading**,
**action line**, **character**, **parenthetical** or **dialogue**.


| Part | Words from the script | Name of the part |
|:---:|--------------------------------------------------|:------------------:|
| a | INT. LIGHTHOUSE – NIGHT | |
| b | Wind shakes the windows. The big lamp is dark. | |
| c | (out of breath) | |
| d | One more step, old man. | |

## Task 2 · A better line and two barks

a) In the first draft, Yusuf says: "As you know, the lamp is broken, and I am
very worried about the ships." Which new line is short, has no "as you
know", and shows the worry? Choose A, B or C.

**A.** "As you know, the lamp is broken. I am worried." **B.** "Three ships
are out there. And my lamp is dark." **C.** "I am very, very worried about
the ships tonight."

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) The player helps Yusuf repair the lamp. Match each bark of Yusuf to its
trigger.

The triggers: **X** the lamp is repaired · **Y** the player opens the lamp
box. Write X or Y after each bark.

**1** "Hand me the wrench!" → \_\_\_\_ · **2** "There! The light is back!" → \_\_\_\_
